title: About Quick Guides
summary: How the little ? button works throughout Iron Rabbit.

cards.heading: What Quick Guides are
cards.body: Quick Guides are short, friendly walk-throughs. Every major screen has a small ? button — tap it to see how that screen works, in five cards or fewer.

cards.heading: How to open one
cards.body: Tap the ? in any screen's header. Swipe left and right through the cards, or use the arrows. Every card teaches exactly one idea.

cards.heading: How to close
cards.body: Tap the X at the top-right. Iron Rabbit asks once to make sure — because closing counts as saying 'I've got it'.

cards.heading: Where to change guide settings
cards.body: Open Settings and scroll to Quick Guides. You can turn all guides off, or enable 'Automatically show' so new screens introduce themselves.

cards.heading: Tip: Guides even when turned off
cards.body: Tip: If Quick Guides are turned off, you can still peek. Tap the ? three times quickly — the guide opens once, just for this screen.
